row_unit: One elected ward in one election
missing: Nulls remain unknown; no missing profile is coded zero.

columns.name: year
columns.description: Election year; 2012, 2017 or 2022. Not a ward panel.

columns.name: ward_number
columns.description: Ward identifier within year, including corporation suffix in 2017.

columns.name: reservation_raw
columns.description: Source seat category: W/WOMAN, G/GENERAL, SC or SCW.

columns.name: assembly_id
columns.description: Assembly constituency; Goyal mapping in 2012/2017, SEC gazette in 2022.

columns.name: winner_party
columns.description: Election roster party; Goyal in 2012/2017, OpenCity/Lok Dhaba in 2022.

columns.name: profile_party
columns.description: MyNeta party; must equal roster party for every linked profile.

columns.name: education
columns.description: MyNeta education category verbatim; unspecified categories are not degrees.

columns.name: age
columns.description: MyNeta age in years; null when absent or unparseable.

columns.name: pending_cases
columns.description: Number of accusation/pending-case table entries, excluding convictions; null if unknown.

columns.name: convicted_cases
columns.description: Separate conviction-table entry count; null if unknown.

columns.name: occupation
columns.description: MyNeta profession verbatim; not used as a quality ranking.

columns.name: source_url
columns.description: Individual MyNeta profile URL; null for unlinked winners.

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 of UTF-8 cached response body.

columns.name: source_capture
columns.description: UTC timestamp when the response was fetched.

columns.name: source_path
columns.description: Cached JSON gzip path relative to qualification_audit.

columns.name: quota
columns.description: 1 for a women-reserved seat, 0 for a seat open to either sex.

columns.name: caste_reservation
columns.description: SC or NONE; distinct from the winner's caste.
